A '''hepatizon shovel''' is the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], made by smithing a [[copper shovel]] with [[hepatizon alloy]]. It digs at speed 20, faster than any other shovel.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the copper item carry over.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It breaks shovel blocks at speed 20 and has 1000 durability.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|5}} damage at an attack speed of 1. While held in the main hand it adds 0.0055 to movement speed, 5.5% of the player's base speed.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_shovel.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* Hepatizon tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.

== History ==
{{History|

{{History line|1.10|A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Mining speed raised from about 13 to 20, to keep hepatizon worth using after adamant.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
